title: Landing Page Action Locomotion Reel
teaches: Keep authored reusable motion in a standalone MotionLoom ActionLibrary document.
Select only the authored actions needed by a scene and reference them through library.action namespaces.
Resolve the same relative ActionLibrary source in native preview and preload it through the existing WASM asset resolver.
Drive the imported GLB with selectively imported standard walk, wave greeting, standard run, and listening idle Action Editor code.
Keep the main showcase graph compact enough to inspect and edit inline.
